テキスト cha 469: A close aide to the ruler of the realm, he is ordered to bring Arata cherries, the raw material of Droga. In Arata he finds residents so hideous they could pass for demons. One, dying, tells him, "Don't lay a hand on Droga." Still he takes the cherries as ordered, but they never take root, and the weakened ruler dies. Seizing the chance, he moves to take the realm. But he knows Droga is not for human hands, so for a time Droga vanishes from history.
